bosses.name: Cursed Puppet
bosses.strategy:
This is basically the same battle as with Yamaraja: War, only easier. As
with Yamaraja: War, the Cursed Puppet will absorb all magic, making
Zhuzhen useful only as a healer. He also uses the Game of Death, just as
usual; if you don't have those Leonardo's Bears equipped to everyone,
they'll have a chance to instantly kill you. His Nightmare attack will
hit the entire party for a lot of damage, so make sure heal afterward.
The only other thing he does is a hellacious physical attack that'll hit
for major damage. Once he starts using Nightmare repeatedly, you could be
in a bit of trouble.

Have Yuri fuse into Inferno and cast Fighting Spirit on himself, followed
by physically attacking Yamaraja every turn. If he has the Mind's Eye
equipped, it won't take very long. Margarete should be attacking
normally, but having her jump in to use Thera Seeds if needed, and
Zhuzhen should focus completely on recovery.

If you're having trouble staying healed, have Yuri fuse into Heaven's
Fiend so you have the whole party healing spell.

As long as you answered the prompts correctly as Alice in Kuihai Tower, you can
go to Kowloon Fortress to find out what happened to Wugui. If you answered
differently... then tough luck; you can't do this side quest.

To get to Kowloon Fortress, make your way to the docks in Huayuan in Shanghai.
Talk to Junk-dealer Taka, the old man beside the ship, and he'll tell you that
he fixed your boat. Board it; you'll be asked if you want to launch the ship.

———————————————————————————————————
   [1] It'll sink, so forget it.
   [2] Let's sail the open seas!
———————————————————————————————————

Choose 2, and a new destination will open on the World Map, and it's only
accessible from this point: Kowloon Fortress. SAVE on the World Map before
entering.

The ring here moves REALLY fast. Normally, equipping the Pocket Watch would
make it run normally, but it has no effect this time, so it'll probably take
you QUITE a few tries to get this. Make sure to win the Mind's Eye before
continuing on; it's arguably the best accessory in the game. It will make the
areas on your Judgment Ring invisible, but it'll DOUBLE (yes, DOUBLE) your
physical attack! Paired with a Jade Lariat and weapons that have the Hit Area
widened on them, (or if you're just that good at Yuri's ring) Yuri becomes
ridiculously overpowered. If you don't win it, reload your last save and try
again. Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!

If you talk to the Silent Peddler here, you'll find out that he also is a
Tight-lipped Merchant with goods for sale! Most notably, he has the Zodiac and
Cosmic Bracelets; the Zodiac Bracelet renders Paralysis and Petrification
ineffectual, and the Cosmic Bracelets renders Poison, Silence, and Confusion
ineffectual. These are two very useful accessories that you may want to buy if
you have the spare cash!

When you're ready, head north to the next area within the fortress. Open the
chest beside the stairs to the north for a [_MANA ROOT_], then go up the stairs
and north to the next area. You'll be at a fork, having to choose to go up two
different sets of stairs. Go up the eastern stairs first, following the path to
the ground. Make your way toward the set of stairs on the right side of the
room, but before going up, go behind them on the back side to find a chest
containing an awesome weapon for Yuri: the [_HAND NEEDLE_]. Equip it
immediately!

Go up the stairs and to the next screen, and in this bloody room, go up the
ladder in the eastern corner; you'll find a [_FACE GUARD_] to the left up here.
Once you have that, descend the ladder and check the table at the bottom of the
screen to find the [_WUGUI ROOM KEY_]. Leave this room the way you entered, and
continue back one more screen to the original fork with two sets of stairs.

Head north and take the western stairs now, continue west to the next area,
climb the stairs here to the next, then enter the door when you reach the path
blocked by a striped gate. Look on the floor to the left near the westernmost
barrel to find a [_SEAL OF THE SOUL_], then move up and right through the next
door to be on the other side of the striped gate. Open the chest to your
southeast for a [_THERA ROOT_], then go up the stairs here to the next area.

Get the [_PURE ROOT_] out of the chest here in the stairwell, then continue up
to the next screen. Move southwest and cross the bridge, opening the chest on
the other side for a [_SOUL BENEDICTION_]. Just above it to the left of the
bridge is either a urinal or a water fountain or something... who knows. In any
case, examine it to find another [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. That's it for treasure, so
go up the stairs to the west and save your game here.

  NOTE     Make sure to equip Leonardo's Bears before entering Wugui's room!
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

finished, and all of the monsters will be gone as well. That's it, so make your
way back to Shanghai.
